title: Tool Tiers
subtitle: Bits, chains and frames
text:
The bit decides what a drill can mine. The body decides how fast.

The standard bit mines up to diamond ore. Obsidian, crying obsidian, ancient debris and other netherite level blocks throw white-hot sparks and do not break.

A Diamond Drill Bit mines them. A steel body runs at 1.25x; an iron body manages only 40% on those blocks.
caption: Drill and chainsaw

steps.text: Tree felling: a Chainsaw with a steel body and a Diamond-Tipped Chain fells a whole natural tree, top down, for 50 FE per log. Sneak to cut a single log. Built log walls are left alone.

steps.note:
Crafting Table
4x Diamond, 2x Steel Plate, 1x Steel Rod

steps.text: With no charge left the motor stays still, digging is slow and nothing drops. Recharge the tool in the Charger.
